data.one_liner: Format text output into columns for terminal tabular data.
data.what_it_does: Formats text output into aligned columns, making it useful for printing tabular data in a terminal. It supports custom column splitters, headers, and header separators, and calls toString() on any object passed in.
use_when: You need to print tabular data nicely aligned in a command-line interface
You want to quickly format lists of strings or objects into columns
avoid_when: You are building graphical user interfaces
You need complex table manipulations like sorting, pagination, or filtering
strengths: Supports custom column splitters and headers
weaknesses: Limited to terminal and text-based formatting
No advanced table features like sorting or styling
